state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 2 (the growth tool) is complete for requests served.** `bun nv scaling` in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` measures all five ladder kinds — `run`, `compile`, `lsp`, `fmt`, `serve` — each a `Measure` there; the module doc is the home of the ramp, the bounds, `EXPECT`, `PEAK_SLACK`, `KINDS` and `AREAS`. Tests: `tools/nv/test/scaling.test.ts`.

**`serve`** boots `nvs serve` on the copy per size, sends `size` GETs over one keep-alive connection with `bun nv bench`'s `HttpConn` and `hammer`, and reads the server's peak memory from `Server.peakMemory` (`tools/nv/cmd/bench.ts`). Its size is requests served only: connections and the size of one request are not measured. The server prints no counts, so the clock decides; `peakGrows` fails a ramp whose peak rises more than `PEAK_SLACK` above its lowest.

**`lsp` callgrind** (`lspInstructions`) has not run yet. **`--iterations --check`** has had no full sweep since a bench whose counts settled but whose clock grew twice started going to callgrind.

**Ladders:** `arrays/sort.nvs` (run, flat), `compiler/functions.nvs` (compile, flat), `traffic/requests.nvs` (serve, flat), `fmt/classes.nvs` (fmt, **grows**), `lsp/classes.nvs` (lsp, **grows**; both written in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What we found*). `--check` fails on those two, and `--areas` names 17 of 22 areas without a ladder. `docs/perf/performance-review.md` does not exist yet (Stage 4).

next.note: one file set: `benches/scaling/<area>/`, run with `bun nv scaling <area>`, and `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` only if an area needs a measure it lacks.

items.text: **Ladders for the core-library areas** — `values`, `strings`, `regex`, `json`, `numbers`, `time`: each a `run` ladder sized by the input it builds, the shape `benches/scaling/arrays/sort.nvs:1` has; `missingAreas` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:756` closes each area as its folder gets one. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`. The goal prose Stage 3 table names what each area grows.

**A `serve` size for one request's size and for connections** — the `request` and `connections` areas grow headers, body size and open connections, which `serveLoad` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:600` does not vary yet: it sends `size` requests of one shape. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

backlog: `nvs serve --count`: per-request counts for a `serve` ladder; the server prints none, so the clock decides alone (goal prose Stage 2, *The bounds*).
`fmt/classes.nvs` and `lsp/classes.nvs` grow: Stage 5's fixes (`docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What we found*).
A full `bun nv scaling --iterations --check` sweep (module doc of `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts`).
